issues.cause: The platform can bypass post_process_code on HTTP errors. The evaluator consequently treated the current cards.list HTTP 404 / FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 WARNING as a missing result and transferred to an agent.
issues.repair: Snapshot and explicitly clear the relevant transport-result fields before each list request. Recover only the documented no-card warning from a fresh failure counter and the current response namespace. Preserve technical-error handling for other statuses, malformed bodies, timeouts and stale responses.

issues.cause: The outside node extracted only an intent. Valid card digits were lost, and its evaluator required a menu yes/no even when the customer clearly resumed the interrupted task.
issues.repair: Extract the same primitive task information during the detour. Restore the saved question and its budget, then replay an in-scope answer exactly once. A yes to the menu question remains menu consent and can never authorize a bank write. Incidental small talk is an unanswered task question rather than an unrelated banking request.

issues.cause: The extractor correctly produced the customer’s literal product name, but the 0.65 confidence threshold discarded it. The deterministic ineligible-card branch therefore never received the name.
issues.repair: Use a 0.4 confidence threshold for literal card-name capture and explicitly require capture regardless of eligibility or whether the name was offered. Eligibility, ownership and uniqueness remain deterministic checks against the loaded card list.

issues.cause: Any extracted card name triggered reselection, including a fresh explicit confirmation naming the already selected card. This erased the email challenge and currency, repeated the balance lookup and prevented sending. Earlier stages also omitted follow-up fields, and actual card corrections discarded correlated email terms.
issues.repair: Resolve references against the loaded list before deciding whether they change the selected card. A unique reference to the current card preserves the challenge; different, unmatched or ambiguous references cannot authorize it. Preserve email currency, period and destination restrictions through actual card corrections, reload the new card and obtain fresh confirmation. Capture these terms in the another-card and offer stages.

value.error_results: A current cards.list HTTP failure may bypass its post-hook. Only HTTP 404 plus the parsed FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 WARNING, correlated with the current request namespace and a fresh failure counter, becomes no_cards. Other errors and stale error text remain failures.
value.detours: An in-scope response can resume the saved task without first requiring a separate menu refusal. Restore its question budget and replay the response once. A menu yes is not transaction consent; resumed confirmation stages must ask for fresh consent.
value.card_references: A uniquely resolved reference to the currently selected card is not a switch. A real email-card correction retains the email request’s currency, period and registered-address restrictions while invalidating the previous confirmation.
value.literal_extraction: Literal card names use min_confidence 0.4. This changes capture only; the loaded list and existing eligibility checks still decide authorization.
value.validation: The complete changed control flow was reviewed statically, including result-only entry, replay, detour return, confirmation corrections and write outcomes. No tools, local checks or live simulations were executed. All existing checks, smoke and scenarios are retained unchanged; new checks are appended.
